column3: Adds selectable bundled feature tiers to existing user pools; referenced login features were recently announced separately.
Introduces delivery-event publication to EventBridge for messaging events.
Adds payload limits, query variables and panel controls to an existing plugin.
Adds proactive policy controls for additional governed resource types.
Extends existing GitLab source integration to group repositories.
Adds Dolby E codec support to existing audio decoding.
Adds verification states and filters to existing anomaly alarms.
Adds MediaConnect as a delivery destination for an existing Link encoder.
Adds a price-and-capacity allocation strategy to existing Spot provisioning.
Raises searchable data and compute capacity ceilings for existing serverless collections.
Spark update explicitly adds query optimization and SQL-function capabilities beyond a version identifier.
API Gateway adds IAM condition keys controlling endpoint exposure, authorization and TLS through existing IAM policies and SCPs.
Adds repeating shift patterns and bulk assignments to existing scheduling.
Adds supported operating-system versions to existing Systems Manager management capabilities.
Regional rollout of existing R6i instances.
MemoryDB changes its contractual Multi-AZ availability SLA from 99.9% to 99.99%; no functional product change is stated.
Adds an instance family and Python runtime versions to existing notebook options.
Adds extracted fields and OCR response data to existing Analyze ID operation.
Introduces a SQL authoring interface for Glue Studio transforms.
EventBridge adds GitHub, Stripe and Twilio sources through deployable webhook templates for its existing event ingestion operation.
Regional rollout of existing Timestream.
Elastic Disaster Recovery adds Outposts racks as replication and recovery destinations while explicitly retaining the same functionality.
EventBridge Pipes gains private VPC connectivity through PrivateLink for existing Pipes operations.
Data Exchange for Redshift describes direct subscription-based queries and automated entitlements at GA but identifies no functional change from any prior preview.
Adds a new Mistral model version to the existing Bedrock model catalog.
Adds collation options and overrides to existing string comparison and SQL operations.
Adds CWL and Toil support to an established multi-engine workflow CLI.
CloudWatch cross-account observability adds Service Quotas as another monitored resource type with dashboards and alarms.
Adds service-level metric aggregation to existing App Runner monitoring.
Introduces controlled ISV access to customers' Q indexes through application registration.
Extends existing hibernation to additional EC2 instance targets.
Extends existing conversational analytics from voice to chat contacts.
Regional rollout of existing Kinesis Video Streams.
Introduces a SPARC-compatible emulated execution environment for rehosting applications on AWS.
Adds compliance attestations without new product functionality.
Batch introduces a queue-front snapshot operation showing fair-share scheduling order through its console and GetJobQueueSnapshot API.
Introduces Evidence Finder search and grouping with CloudTrail Lake ingestion and reporting.
Extends existing SNS tracing to FIFO topics.
Regional rollout of the existing Redshift Data API.
Regional rollout of the existing EventBridge Scheduler.
Adds asynchronous invocation measurements to existing Lambda CloudWatch monitoring.
Regional rollout of existing high-memory EC2 instances.
Regional rollout of existing EC2 D3 instances.
Regional rollout of the existing AQUA accelerator.
Adds comparison operators to existing dynamic recommendation filters.
Regional rollout of existing Graviton-backed OpenSearch instances.
Adds private endpoint connectivity for existing CloudHSM management APIs.
Regional rollout of existing S3 on Outposts.
Adds modeling syntax, default values and type controls to existing Smithy code generation.
Adds configurable before/after hooks to existing patch installations.
Adds supported key algorithms to existing user authentication.
Adds file-level commit-history viewing to existing repository console navigation.
Introduces another geographic Local Zone location.
EMR on EKS enriches the existing DescribeJobRun response with relevant driver-log error details.
Adds managed permission policies for existing ROSA infrastructure operations.
Adds hypothetical-index query-plan evaluation through HypoPG alongside routine engine and extension versions.
Regional rollout of existing Firewall Manager.
Regional rollout of existing snapshot export.
Adds Bedrock as an observed dependency target within existing Application Signals.
Introduces automated profile matching and rule-based identity consolidation.
Adds Office subscription and installation configuration to existing WorkSpaces image creation.
Extends existing Shield policy management to automatic layer-7 mitigation controls.
Introduces template-library authoring, versioning and stack lifecycle operations within Application Manager.
Adds interruptible spare-capacity selection for existing Glue job execution with otherwise unchanged capabilities.
Adds natural-language coverage to existing agent assistance.
Regional rollout of existing C7i instances.
Adds SPICE consumption measurements to QuickSight monitoring through CloudWatch.
Adds language analyzers to an existing plugin integration mechanism.
Data Exchange introduces in-place subscriber access to provider S3 objects without copies, with access governed by subscriptions.
Regional rollout of existing ElastiCache autoscaling.
Regional rollout of existing Chime meeting endpoints and media.
Adds ECS runtime findings to existing Detective investigations.
Raises throughput quotas for existing FIFO queues.
Introduces workflow-run archiving and history export through CloudWatch Logs.
Refines provisioning and onboarding in an existing Sidewalk integration.
Launch Wizard adds an option to place SQL Server tempdb on instance-store volumes during the existing deployment flow.
Regional rollout of existing C6g and R6gd instances.
Proton allows environments to link existing shared resources via customer-managed templates instead of provisioning those resources anew.
Adds HIPAA eligibility without new product functionality.
Adds rule ordering and default action controls to existing firewall policies.
Introduces data subscription access through Lake Formation catalog and permissions integration.
Adds cross-account delegation to existing S3 access-point policies.
Regional rollout of existing Nitro Enclaves and certificate integration.
Adds PCI compliance certification without new product functionality.
Introduces educational courses and certificates.
Adds customer-authored permissions to existing resource sharing.
AMS Accelerate becomes available in GovCloud; the text describes existing operational capabilities without a functional delta.
Alongside regional expansion, the post explicitly makes Graviton2 instances the default ElastiCache choice; other described changes are routine hardware and runtime versions.
JumpStart adds a programmatic Python interface explicitly enabling automated deployment and training of previously one-click models.
Adds widget choices and arrangement controls to existing Batch dashboards.
Introduces reusable, centrally published contact-flow modules.
Runtime release explicitly adds language constructs and API enhancements beyond a version identifier.
Refines anomaly-console presentation, metadata and error messages.
Introduces node problem-detection/recovery and Kubernetes monitoring tools alongside kernel optimizations.
Adds customer-managed encryption-key selection to existing state machines and activities.
Adds YAML format compatibility to existing workflow authoring and provisioning.
Customer Profiles now automatically stores Connect contact history in unified customer profiles, replacing the described custom profile-building work.

Adds client-side encryption parameters and changes defaults in existing database networking.
Engine update explicitly adds session controls and stored-procedure return data.
Extends existing personalization automation to domain recommenders and segmentation configurations.
Adds SDK wrappers for existing Neptune data-plane APIs.
Adds Keyspaces as a managed target in the existing Service Quotas console.
Introduces generated query suggestions with suggestion rules and blocking controls.
Bedrock Blueprints are open-source sample templates for experimenting and learning with existing agents, actions, guardrails and knowledge bases.
Introduces Slack runbook search, execution and progress interaction through Chatbot.
Adds retraining schedules and defaults to existing Personalize solution training.
New Linux release explicitly adds repository version locking and update controls.
Regional rollout of existing Glue.

Regional rollout of existing Service Quotas.
Adds outbound-call exclusion configuration to existing agent-routing order.
Regional rollout of existing Backup Audit Manager.
Extends existing ECS Exec and operating-system support to on-premises targets.
Regional rollout of existing CodePipeline.
Personalize gains an integrated Data Wrangler preparation workflow with transformations and exploration before dataset import.
B2B Data Interchange adds automatic generation of 997 and TA1 acknowledgement artifacts and corresponding delivery-triggering events.
Adds routine minor MySQL versions with fixes and generic improvements.
Adds storage-optimized hardware options to the existing EC2 instance catalog.
FSx ONTAP is rolled out to three more regions.
Existing DataBrew is rolled out to GovCloud West.
Existing Snowball devices become available in Jakarta.
Private 5G adds multiple radio units and additional SIM ordering to scale an existing private network.
Introduces Incident Manager incident synchronization and response integration with Jira.
Adds HIPAA transaction formats to existing EDI transformation operations.
FSx File Gateway introduces a deployable gateway type with local caching to extend managed FSx shares on premises, a substantial Storage Gateway subsystem.
Existing Flink analytics service expands to three regions.
Advanced NodeJS Driver GA describes topology-aware failover and authentication features but does not establish an inaugural launch or a functional GA delta.
New edge location is geographic expansion despite associated latency benefits.

CodeBuild expands to Jakarta.
Adds CWL compatibility to existing managed workflow execution.
Existing Config functionality expands to Melbourne.
Introduces bidirectional Jira issue and Security Hub finding synchronization.
Explicitly extends already available CloudShell capabilities to remaining commercial regions.
Existing C6in instances expand to Hyderabad.
Adds deliverability diagnosis, recommendations and automated sending optimization.
Extends existing Contact Lens analytics to external voice system inputs.
Adds user-supplied and external identifiers to existing asset resources.
CloudFormation extends AllowedValues and AllowedPattern validation controls to CommaDelimitedList parameters.
GovCloud rollout of the same scaling behavior announced for all commercial regions on 2023-12-06; the earlier AWS source confirms identical rates and granularity.
Routine quarterly security and critical runtime updates.
Adds property overrides to existing Copilot resource provisioning.
Introduces self-service listing creation and updates replacing manually processed requests.
Optimizes existing Connect audio for Citrix desktop environments.
Explicit GA delta adds real-time payload redaction and masking operations.
Q Business adds Smartsheet to its existing set of index synchronization connectors.
Redshift adds SQL MERGE and multidimensional aggregation operations including CUBE and ROLLUP; these outweigh the accompanying size-limit increase.
Existing EMR Serverless expands to four regions.
Adds Lake Formation as the authorization method for existing crawler data access.
Extends existing model enrichment with calculated geographical distance inputs.
DocumentDB adds managed unplanned global failover preserving cluster topology, distinct from its existing planned switchover operation.
Adds a newer foundation model to the Bedrock catalog.
HealthImaging extends its existing DICOM import operation to S3 buckets in other accounts and regions.
Adds transaction logs as a backup input option to existing migration workflows.
Introduces native message archiving and replay operations for SNS FIFO topics.
Adds another sign-in provider and linked login options to existing community profiles.
Introduces canary event emission to EventBridge for downstream actions.
Introduces a genomics command-line workflow provisioning interface at launch.
Adds automatic Spark code upgrade planning, rewriting and validation.
Extends existing backend resource provisioning to custom resources via CDK or CloudFormation.
Adds standardized per-user detail to existing cost and usage reporting.
Adds calendar-based blocking controls to existing desired-state enforcement.
Time Sync adds configurable PTP hardware-clock support and clock-accuracy auditing alongside automatic NTP accuracy improvements.
Extends existing Transit Gateway connectivity to lower-speed connection options.
Existing Well-Architected Tool expands to GovCloud.
Introduces a programmatic interface for clearing missed-contact notifications.
Mobile console expands to Osaka region.
Adds another foundation model size to the Bedrock model catalog.
Extends artifact management with OCI reference relationships and lifecycle handling.
Adds three resource targets to existing CloudFormation integration.
EC2 adds a bare-metal size of the existing C7gn family with specified capacity and networking characteristics.
Amplify announces in-app messaging GA and describes campaign and UI features without specifying changes from its prior release stage.
Adds language compatibility to existing conversational processing.
IoT Device Management adds reusable templates and access controls for existing remote job actions and their deployment parameters.
Adds a higher-performance storage volume option to existing RDS storage provisioning.
Existing cross-region backup feature expands to four regions.
Extends existing inference testing with existing-endpoint targets, controls and SDK support.
Adds a flow rebalancing configuration option to existing gateway load balancing.
Introduces managed Edge Manager agent and model deployment through Greengrass components.
Lake Formation expands to Zurich; the body only explains established data-lake capabilities.
Adds a bounding-polygon filter to existing tracked-device position queries.
Extends existing Glue catalog integration with statistics for query optimization.
Adds product lifecycle dates and initial-value controls to existing demand forecasting.
IAM adds centralized removal of member-account root credentials and scoped privileged operations using temporary credentials.
Existing EFS replication expands to remaining regions.
Introduces a web console interface for existing session management APIs.
CloudFormation gains PCS resource support for creating and managing existing cluster resources through infrastructure templates.
Adds previous-contact context carryover to existing chat creation.
Step Functions gains a general AWS SDK invocation interface spanning service API actions, beyond the previous curated service integrations.
Raises existing image extraction sampling frequency.
Adds manager participation in live calls through barge-in.
Adds Windows Server 2025 images to the existing EC2 operating-system catalog.
Existing SNS SMS sending expands to Jakarta.
Introduces database performance diagnosis and bottleneck visualization.
Neptune GSP adds whole-named-graph variants of existing fetch, insert and delete operations; the source explicitly contrasts these with multiple existing SPARQL queries.
Introduces the distinct AWS Wickr enterprise communications offering.
FinSpace Scaling Groups allow multiple existing kdb clusters to share provisioned compute, adding a placement and utilization option.
Changes MediaTailor log pricing to volume-based vended-log tiers.
